d: Aaj ki pramukh khabron men svasthy, nirvachan, parv-tyohar aur kanun-vyavastha se juri aham khabren shamil hain. kainsar marijon ko bari rahat dete hue aaj se 137 enti kainsar davaon ki kimton men karib 70 pratishat tak ki kami ki gaee hai. is phaisle se kainsar marijon ko salana lagbhag 3,500 karor rupye ki bachat hone ka anuman hai. vahin, esaaaeeaar ke tahat dava-aapatti charan men prapt aavednon ka dijitaijeshan jari hai. ab tak char tarah ke 15 lakh se adhik prapatron ka dijitaijeshan kiya ja chuka hai. mukhy nirvachan padadhikari ne samaveshi matdata suchi taiyar karne par vishesh…
